description_en: Calls the StopRecordTask operation to stop a video recording task
description_zh: 调用StopRecordTask停止视频录制任务
kebab_example: aliyun rtc stop-record-task --app-id yourAppId --task-id yourTaskId --region cn-hangzhou
name: StopRecordTask

parameters.help_en: The application ID. Create and query the ID in the console. Only a single ID is supported
parameters.help_zh: 应用ID。通过控制台创建和查询，仅支持传单个ID
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The task ID. Only a single ID is supported. The value must be the same as the TaskId parameter of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/193528.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 任务ID。仅支持传单个ID，和https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/193528.html入参TaskId一致
parameters.name: task_id
